23-s119.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 23, с. 119. Выучи, как пишутся новые слова.
steps: to depend on — зависеть от; independence — независимость; to fight (fought) — сражаться; a fight — бой; gold — золото; golden — золотой; empty — пустой; to be situated in — располагаться в; gun — ружьё.
23-s119.answer: depend on, independence, fight/fought, gold, golden, empty, situated, gun

1-s119.condition: Lesson 48, упр. 1, с. 119. Скажи несколько предложений о коренных американцах и их традициях.
steps: Native Americans were peaceful people. They lived in small earth houses and grew their own food. They believed in many gods who lived in trees, stones, water and fire. One of their traditions was smoking the pipe of peace: when they smoked it with strangers, it meant friendship and peace.
1-s119.answer: peaceful; earth houses; many gods; the pipe of peace = friendship

2-s119.condition: Lesson 48, упр. 2, с. 119. Составь вопросы другу о его опыте (Have you ever…?).
steps: Have you ever seen a Native American? Have you ever been to San Francisco? Have you ever lived in a wooden house? Have you ever hunted wild animals? Have you ever eaten nuts?
2-s119.answer: Have you ever seen / been to / lived in / hunted / eaten …?

3-s120.condition: Lesson 48, упр. 3, с. 120. Расскажи, когда, почему и с кем американцы боролись за независимость и каков результат.
steps: In the 18th century the Americans began to fight for independence because they didn't want to depend on the English King. They fought against England and won — the United States of America appeared.
3-s120.answer: 18th century; against England; didn't want to depend on the King; they got independence

4-s120.condition: Lesson 48, упр. 4, с. 120. Скажи, где расположены здания и памятники Москвы на картинках (is situated).
steps: The Kremlin Palace is situated on the territory of the Kremlin. The Uspensky Cathedral is situated in the Kremlin. The Tretyakov Gallery is situated near the Moskva River. The monument to Pushkin is situated in Pushkin Square. The monument to Gagarin is situated in Gagarin Square.
4-s120.answer: … is situated in the Kremlin / near the river / in Pushkin Square / in Gagarin Square

5-s121.condition: Lesson 48, упр. 5, с. 121. Научись произносить новые слова (см. упр. 8).
steps: protect /prəˈtekt/ — protected; dangerous /ˈdeɪndʒərəs/; snake /sneɪk/; tailor /ˈteɪlə/; through /θruː/.

6-s121.condition: Lesson 48, упр. 6, с. 121. Прочитай слова и догадайся об их значении.
steps: tradition — традиция; cowboy — ковбой.

7-s121.condition: Lesson 48, упр. 7, с. 121. Прочитай новые слова парами.
steps: danger — dangerous; sailor — tailor; lake — snake.

8-s121.condition: Lesson 48, упр. 8, с. 121. Научись произносить и использовать новые слова.
steps: protect — защищать: we wear coats to protect ourselves from the cold; people must protect nature. dangerous — опасный: a dangerous journey, a dangerous animal; the life of the colonists was dangerous. snake — змея: there are many snakes here. tailor — портной: a tailor makes clothes. through — сквозь, через: walk through the forest, look through the window.

9-s121.condition: Lesson 48, упр. 9, с. 121. Скажи, что или кого должны защищать люди.
steps: People must protect animals, nature, birds, little children, plants, fish, rivers, seas and forests.
9-s121.answer: People must protect animals, nature, birds, children, plants, fish, rivers, seas, forests.

10-s121.condition: Lesson 48, упр. 10, с. 121. Прочитай, что говорит хвастун Джон, и вырази сомнение (разделительные вопросы).
steps: A dangerous snake lives under your bed, doesn't it? You can work as a tailor, can't you? You can protect all the little children in your school, can't you? You have fought a lot of dangerous animals, haven't you? You've got five real guns, haven't you? You have hunted bears with a gun, haven't you?
10-s121.answer: …, doesn't it? …, can't you? …, haven't you?

11-s122.condition: Lesson 48, упр. 11, с. 122. Скажи, что, по-твоему, делать опасно.
steps: I think it's dangerous to cross the road at a red light. It's dangerous to walk alone at night. It's dangerous to swim in a cold river. It's dangerous to play with fire.

12-s122.condition: Lesson 48, упр. 12, с. 122. Составь правдивые предложения (look through).
steps: The boy is looking through the photos. My cousin is looking through the newspapers. His friend is looking through the pictures. The doctor is looking through the texts.
12-s122.answer: … is looking through the photos / newspapers / pictures / texts

13-s122.condition: Lesson 48, упр. 13, с. 122. Прослушай, прочитай и выучи стихотворение.
steps: Смысл колыбельной: звёзды погасли, взошла луна, пора спать; спи спокойно, а утром взойдёт солнце; у тебя всегда будет друг, где бы ты ни был. Читаем и учим наизусть.

14-s123.condition: Lesson 48, упр. 14, с. 123. Прочитай текст и скажи, кто был первым портным, сшившим джинсы.
steps: Levi Strauss was the first tailor who made jeans.

15-s124.condition: Lesson 48, упр. 15, с. 124. Закончи предложения и прочитай вслух.
steps: 1. …cowboy clothes. 2. …hats, boots and jeans. 3. …it was more comfortable to walk through long grass in boots. 4. …San Francisco. 5. …all over the world.
15-s124.answer: cowboy clothes; hats, boots and jeans; through long grass; San Francisco; all over the world

16-s124.condition: Lesson 48, упр. 16, с. 124. Ответь на вопросы по тексту.
steps: 1. Cowboy clothes. 2. Hats protected them from the hot sun; boots were comfortable and protected them from snakes. 3. They wore jeans. 4. Levi Strauss. 5. He lived in San Francisco. 6. Because jeans are popular all over the world.
16-s124.answer: cowboy clothes; hats and boots protect; jeans; Levi Strauss; San Francisco; popular everywhere

17-s124.condition: Lesson 48, упр. 17, с. 124. Расскажи всё, что помнишь о ковбойской одежде.
steps: Clothes in the Wild West helped people in their hard and dangerous life. Cowboys wore hats, boots and jeans. Hats protected their faces and eyes from the hot sun. Boots were comfortable, protected from dangerous snakes and made riding easier. Jeans were strong and comfortable — the first jeans were made by Levi Strauss.
17-s124.answer: hats — sun; boots — snakes, riding; jeans — Levi Strauss

18-s124.condition: Lesson 48, упр. 18, с. 124. Выполни упр. 10 письменно: a) вырази сомнение; b) не согласись.
steps: a) I don't think you've got a snake under your bed. To be honest, you can't work as a tailor. Correct me if I'm wrong, but you've got only toy guns. I don't think you've hunted bears.
b) I'm not sure you're right. I'm afraid I can't agree with you. You can't be serious! You must be joking!
18-s124.answer: a) I don't think… / To be honest…; b) I can't agree / You must be joking!

19-s124.condition: Lesson 48, упр. 19, с. 124. Выполни упр. 12 письменно.
steps: The boy is looking through the books. The girls are looking through the photos. My cousins are looking through the pictures. His friend is looking through the newspapers. The doctor is looking through the magazines.
19-s124.answer: … is / are looking through the books / photos / pictures / newspapers / magazines

20-s124.condition: Lesson 48, упр. 20, с. 124. Дополни разделительные вопросы.
steps: 1. …, have you? 2. …, hasn't he? 3. …, hasn't she? 4. …, have we? 5. …, didn't he?
20-s124.answer: have you? hasn't he? hasn't she? have we? didn't he?

21-s124.condition: Lesson 48, упр. 21, с. 124. Выучи новые слова.
steps: to protect — защищать; dangerous — опасный; snake — змея; tailor — портной; through — через.

1-s125.condition: Review 6, упр. 1, с. 125. Расскажи об открытии Америки и первых английских поселениях.
steps: Christopher Columbus, a seaman from Italy who lived in Spain, was sent to India by the Spanish King and Queen in 1492. He sailed west because he knew the Earth was round and reached a new land — America. Later, in 1620, English people sailed from Plymouth on the Mayflower and started the first English colony in the New World.
1-s125.answer: Columbus, 1492, sailed west to India, discovered America; 1620 — the Mayflower, the first English colony

2-s125.condition: Review 6, упр. 2, с. 125. Расскажи о коренных американцах.
steps: Native Americans came from Asia. They lived in earth and wooden houses, grew food, hunted and fished. They believed in many gods and had ceremonies with music and dances before hunting or farming. Long ago they lived all over the USA; now most live in poor lands to the west of the Mississippi.
2-s125.answer: from Asia; hunters, farmers; many gods; ceremonies; now west of the Mississippi

3-s125.condition: Review 6, упр. 3, с. 125. Скажи, почему американцы начали переезжать на запад.
steps: They moved west to look for new lands, and in the 19th century — for gold.
3-s125.answer: to look for new lands and gold

4-s125.condition: Review 6, упр. 4, с. 125. Расскажи, какие праздники отмечают в Америке.
steps: Americans celebrate Thanksgiving Day on the fourth Thursday of November with a traditional dinner — roast turkey and pumpkin pie. Independence Day is on 4 July — the birthday of the USA; people have picnics and watch fireworks. They also celebrate Christmas and New Year.
4-s125.answer: Thanksgiving (November), Independence Day (4 July), Christmas, New Year

5-s125.condition: Review 6, упр. 5, с. 125. Расскажи о праздниках в России.
steps: The most important holidays in Russia are New Year's Day and Victory Day. On New Year's Day people gather together, cook traditional food and make wishes. Victory Day on 9 May is the greatest national holiday — people watch the parade in Red Square.
5-s125.answer: New Year's Day, Victory Day (9 May), Christmas, Women's Day

6-s125.condition: Review 6, упр. 6, с. 125. Закончи диалог и разыграй его.
steps: Bob: Oh, it's a fantastic film. Alex: Yes, very interesting. I'm fond of cartoons. Bob: They are never boring and can tell you about life in America. Are you interested in American history? Alex: Yes, I am. Have you read a lot about the country? Bob: Not much, but I know some facts about Columbus and the first colonies.
6-s125.answer: Диалог о фильме и интересе к истории Америки.

7-s125.condition: Review 6, упр. 7, с. 125. Придумай вопросы, которые могут задать друг другу Боб и Алекс.
steps: Would you like to visit America? What holidays in America do you know? When do people celebrate Thanksgiving Day? When do they celebrate Independence Day? Who discovered America?
7-s125.answer: Would you like to visit…? What holidays…? When…? Who discovered…?

8-s125.condition: Review 6, упр. 8, с. 125. Найди слова по теме «Америка» и быстро прочитай их.
steps: state — штат; settlement — поселение; Native American — коренной американец; Columbus — Колумб; pipe of peace — трубка мира; Thanksgiving Day — День благодарения; independence — независимость; cowboy — ковбой.
8-s125.answer: state, settlement, Native American, Columbus, pipe of peace, Thanksgiving Day, independence, cowboy

9-s126.condition: Review 6, упр. 9, с. 126. Прочитай текст «Мой друг Эдвард» и скажи, почему его знали все в рыбацком посёлке.
steps: Everybody knew Edward because wherever he went, something special happened to him.
9-s126.answer: Wherever he went, something special happened to him.

10-s126.condition: Review 6, упр. 10, с. 126. Скажи: true, false или don't know.
steps: 1. True. 2. Don't know. 3. False — you could reach the island only by boat. 4. False — he told some stories. 5. False — he drew many pictures. 6. True.
10-s126.answer: true, don't know, false, false, false, true

11-s127.condition: Review 6, упр. 11, с. 127. Поставь глаголы во 2-ю и 3-ю формы, раздели на правильные и неправильные.
steps: Regular: discover — discovered — discovered; sail — sailed; appear — appeared; prepare — prepared; smoke — smoked; depend — depended.
Irregular: be — was/were — been; fight — fought — fought; sell — sold — sold.
11-s127.answer: regular — discover, sail, appear, prepare, smoke, depend; irregular — be, fight, sell

12-s127.condition: Review 6, упр. 12, с. 127. Закончи предложения, вставив for или since.
steps: 1. since; 2. for; 3. since; 4. for; 5. since.

13-s127.condition: Review 6, упр. 13, с. 127. Напиши слова, противоположные по значению.
steps: comfortable — uncomfortable; interesting — uninteresting; downstairs — upstairs; short — long; fast — slow; miss a bus — catch a bus; easy — difficult; poor — rich; round — square; happy — unhappy; true — false; beautiful — ugly; behind — in front of; clean — dirty; cheap — expensive; weak — strong; buy — sell.
13-s127.answer: uncomfortable, uninteresting, upstairs, long, slow, catch, difficult, rich, square, unhappy, false, ugly, in front of, dirty, expensive, strong, sell

1-s128.condition: Lesson 50, упр. 1, с. 128. Угадай слова по описаниям.
steps: snake, tailor, gun, gold, dangerous, empty, independence.
1-s128.answer: snake, tailor, gun, gold, dangerous, empty, independence

2-s128.condition: Lesson 50, упр. 2, с. 128. Скажи, от чего мы зависим в поездке.
steps: When we go on a journey we depend on money, on transport, on our parents, on our knowledge of foreign languages, on our luggage and on the weather.
2-s128.answer: we depend on money, transport, parents, languages, luggage, the weather

3-s128.condition: Lesson 50, упр. 3, с. 128. Представь себя учителем и придумай вопросы ученикам со словами из рамки.
steps: Why do people fight against crime? What depends on the weather? Why is it bad to smoke? Should people hunt animals? Did you prepare well for the test? When did the first people appear in America? Who sails the oceans? Who discovered America? Who is interested in science?
3-s128.answer: Вопросы с fight, depend, smoke, hunt, prepare, appear, sail, discover, be interested in

4-s129.condition: Lesson 50, упр. 4, с. 129. Расставь предложения по порядку, чтобы получилась история, и закончи её.
steps: Порядок: 9, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 3, 1, 2. Окончание: the tailor said he was upset that she had left, bought a gun and protected the house himself.

look-read-remember-s129.condition: Lesson 50, с. 129. Ознакомься с правилом (May I…?).
steps: May I …? — просьба разрешить. Ответы: Yes, you may. / Certainly. / Yes, please. — разрешение; I'm afraid not. / No, you mustn't. — отказ.
May I take the cake? — Of course, I made it for you. May I open the window? — I'm afraid not, I'm cold.
look-read-remember-s129.answer: May I…? — Yes, you may / I'm afraid not

5-s130.condition: Lesson 50, упр. 5, с. 130. Переделай вопросы в вежливые просьбы с May I…?
steps: May I take your pen, please? May I have your address, please? May I go with you, please? May I see the album, please? May I see the picture, please?
5-s130.answer: May I take / have / go / see …, please?

6-s130.condition: Lesson 50, упр. 6, с. 130. Спроси разрешения, используя словосочетания; партнёр отвечает.
steps: May I open the window? — Yes, you may. May I go to the theatre? — Yes, you may. May I take your father's gun? — No, you mustn't, it's dangerous. May I live on an island? — I'm afraid not. May I watch the cartoon? — Yes, you may.
6-s130.answer: May I …? — Yes, you may / No, you mustn't / I'm afraid not

7-s130.condition: Lesson 50, упр. 7, с. 130. Узнай, как произносить и использовать новые слова.
steps: each — каждый: each flower, each pupil had a book, ten roubles each; each other — друг друга; government — правительство: the Russian government; letter — письмо, буква; newspaper — газета; magazine — журнал; own — собственный: my own room; sell — sold — sold — продавать; state — штат; may — мочь (разрешение).
7-s130.answer: each, each other, government, letter, newspaper, magazine, own, sell/sold, state, may

8-s130.condition: Lesson 50, упр. 8, с. 130. Прочитай слова и угадай их значение.
steps: national — национальный; official — официальный; soldier — солдат; statue — статуя.

9-s130.condition: Lesson 50, упр. 9, с. 130. Прочитай новые слова.
steps: letter /ˈletə/, newspaper /ˈnjuːzpeɪpə/, own /əʊn/, sell /sel/ — sold /səʊld/, state /steɪt/, each /iːtʃ/, government /ˈɡʌvənmənt/.
9-s130.answer: letter, newspaper, own, sell/sold, state, each, government

10-s130.condition: Lesson 50, упр. 10, с. 130. Прочитай новые слова и предложения.
steps: The cook gave each child two apples. We have known each other for ten years. A country needs a strong government. I don't like writing letters. He reads newspapers and magazines every morning. I have my own room. They sell fruit in this shop. There are fifty states in the USA.
10-s130.answer: each, each other, government, letter, newspaper, magazine, own, sell, state

11-s131.condition: Lesson 50, упр. 11, с. 131. Ответь на вопросы, используя новые слова.
steps: People read newspapers and magazines. They sell shoes in a shoe shop. I rarely write letters. There are 33 letters in the Russian alphabet. There are 50 states in the USA. Yes, I have my own room.
11-s131.answer: newspapers, magazines; shoes; rarely; 33 letters; 50 states; my own room

12-s131.condition: Lesson 50, упр. 12, с. 131. Прослушай, прочитай и выучи песню об американских монетах.
steps: Слова: a penny — 1 цент, a nickel — 5 центов, a dime — 10 центов, a quarter — 25 центов, a dollar — 100 центов. Слушаем, читаем и поём.

13-s132.condition: Lesson 50, упр. 13, с. 132. Научись читать имена собственные.
steps: New York — Нью-Йорк; France — Франция; the Statue of Liberty — Статуя Свободы; Liberty Island — остров Свободы; The Star-Spangled Banner — «Знамя, усыпанное звёздами» (гимн США).
13-s132.answer: New York, France, the Statue of Liberty, Liberty Island, The Star-Spangled Banner

14-s132.condition: Lesson 50, упр. 14, с. 132. Прочитай и переведи текст о символах США.
steps: Американский флаг называют «Звёзды и полосы». На нём три цвета: красный, белый и синий. 50 звёзд — по одной на каждый штат, 13 полос (7 красных и 6 белых) — по одной на каждую из первых колоний. Статуя Свободы — подарок Франции, стоит на острове Свободы в Нью-Йорке. Гимн — «Знамя, усыпанное звёздами».
14-s132.answer: The Stars and Stripes: 50 stars, 13 stripes; the Statue of Liberty — a gift from France; the anthem

15-s134.condition: Lesson 50, упр. 15, с. 134. Ответь на вопросы об американском флаге.
steps: 1. «The Stars and Stripes». 2. Red, white and blue. 3. There are 50 states. 4. 50 stars — one for each state. 5. 13 stripes. 6. Seven red and six white. 7. One stripe for each of the first 13 colonies. 8. Americans are very proud of their flag.
15-s134.answer: The Stars and Stripes; red, white, blue; 50 states; 50 stars; 13 stripes; 7 red + 6 white; first colonies; proud

16-s134.condition: Lesson 50, упр. 16, с. 134. Дополни список символов США третьим символом и расскажи о нём.
steps: The third symbol is the eagle. It became the official symbol of the country in 1782. The eagle holds an olive branch as a symbol of peace and arrows as a symbol of strength.
16-s134.answer: the eagle — official symbol since 1782; olive branch (peace), arrows (strength)

17-s134.condition: Lesson 50, упр. 17, с. 134. Обсуди с одноклассником символы США: вопросы и ответы.
steps: What are the three symbols of the USA? — The flag, the Statue of Liberty and the eagle. What colours are on the flag? — Red, white and blue. Why is it called «The Stars and Stripes»? — It has stars and stripes on it. How many stars and stripes are there? — 50 stars and 13 stripes. Where is the Statue of Liberty? — On Liberty Island in New York.
17-s134.answer: flag, Statue of Liberty, eagle; red, white, blue; 50 stars, 13 stripes; Liberty Island

18-s134.condition: Lesson 50, упр. 18, с. 134. Расскажи всё, что знаешь о символах Америки.
steps: The USA has three symbols: the flag, the Statue of Liberty and the eagle. The flag is red, white and blue; it is called «The Stars and Stripes» — 50 stars for 50 states and 13 stripes for the first 13 colonies. The Statue of Liberty was a gift from France and stands on Liberty Island in New York. The eagle has been the official symbol since 1782.
18-s134.answer: the flag (50 stars, 13 stripes), the Statue of Liberty (gift from France, New York), the eagle (since 1782)

19-s134.condition: Lesson 50, упр. 19, с. 134. Дополни предложения по смыслу.
steps: 1. blue; 2. stripes; 3. stars; 4. states; 5. colours.

20-s134.condition: Lesson 50, упр. 20, с. 134. Составь вопросы с May I…? по образцу.
steps: 1. May I open the window? 2. May I have some money? 3. May I sit down here? 4. May I go out? 5. May I watch TV now?
20-s134.answer: May I open / have / sit down / go out / watch …?

21-s135.condition: Lesson 50, упр. 21, с. 135. Потренируй написание новых слов.
steps: each — каждый; state — штат; government — правительство; magazine — журнал; newspaper — газета; sell — продавать; letter — письмо; own — собственный; may — мочь.
21-s135.answer: each, state, government, magazine, newspaper, sell, letter, own, may

1-s135.condition: Lesson 51, упр. 1, с. 135. Вежливо попроси (May I…?).
steps: May I take your pen? May I read Nick's magazine? May I take the newspaper? May I read your letter? May I sit down? May I open the window? May I go to the cinema tonight?
1-s135.answer: May I take / read / sit down / open / go …?

2-s135.condition: Lesson 51, упр. 2, с. 135. Ответь на вопросы упр. 1 и объясни ответ.
steps: Of course you may — I have another one. Of course, Nick has already read it. Of course, there are some interesting articles. No, you mustn't — it's personal. Of course, the armchair is comfortable. I'm afraid not — it's raining. No, you mustn't — granny is coming tonight.
2-s135.answer: Of course, you may / No, you mustn't / I'm afraid not + причина

3-s136.condition: Lesson 51, упр. 3, с. 136. Посмотри на картинку и скажи, что продаётся в магазине.
steps: They sell nuts, badges, newspapers, T-shirts, sweets, toys and magazines in the shop.
3-s136.answer: nuts, badges, newspapers, T-shirts, sweets, toys, magazines

4-s136.condition: Lesson 51, упр. 4, с. 136. Скажи, что есть у Ника (own).
steps: It is my own collection of badges. They are my own stamps, magazines, coins, pictures. It is my own garden, flat, book, plate.
4-s136.answer: my own collection / stamps / magazines / coins / garden / flat / pictures / book / plate

5-s136.condition: Lesson 51, упр. 5, с. 136. Составь предложения по образцу (each … government).
steps: Each state must have a good government. Each country must have a clever government. Each country can have a strong government. Each state can have a democratic government.
5-s136.answer: Each state / country must (can) have a good / clever / strong government.

6-s137.condition: Lesson 51, упр. 6, с. 137. Перепиши предложения в прошедшем и будущем времени (could / will be able to).
steps: Past: We could wake up early. They could become architects. He could become rich. She could go on a trip.
Future: We will be able to wake up early. They will be able to become architects. He will be able to become rich. She will be able to go on a trip.

7-s137.condition: Lesson 51, упр. 7, с. 137. Скажи, во что одеты мальчики и девочки.
steps: Tom is wearing a green jacket, green trousers and a yellow shirt. Nick is wearing a red T-shirt, yellow shorts and boots. Andrew is wearing a brown sweater, green trousers and yellow boots. Bob is wearing a blue cap, a yellow jacket, jeans and trainers. Sally is wearing a violet blouse, a white skirt and violet shoes. Liz is wearing a yellow sweater and a blue skirt.
7-s137.answer: … is wearing a jacket / T-shirt / sweater / cap / blouse / skirt / boots / trainers

8-s137.condition: Lesson 51, упр. 8, с. 137. Скажи, что Боб не смог сделать вчера, но сможет во вторник.
